title: Create GSD-style project structure
description: Establish .planning/ directory structure mirroring GSD for state management and phase tracking
rationale: GSD uses .planning/ as the single source of truth. This enables STATE.md tracking, phase organization, and artifact storage.
steps: Create .planning/ directory in workspace root
Create .planning/phases/ for phase-specific artifacts
Create .planning/research/ for research outputs
Create .planning/todos/ with pending/ and done/ subdirs
Create STATE.md template (under 100 lines, tracks position/decisions/blockers)
Create PROJECT.md template (core value, constraints, decisions table)
Add init command to proactive-amcp.sh: 'gsd init'
Verify: running 'gsd init' creates structure

title: Implement CONTEXT.md decision capture
description: Add discuss-phase equivalent that captures user decisions BEFORE planning, with LOCKED/DISCRETION/DEFERRED sections
rationale: GSD insight: Plans without context force guessing. CONTEXT.md locks decisions so downstream agents don't re-ask users.
steps: Create templates/CONTEXT.md with sections: Phase Boundary, Implementation Decisions, Specific Ideas, Deferred Ideas
Create discuss.sh script that guides context capture
Implement gray-area detection based on phase type (visual/API/CLI/content/organization)
Add 'gsd discuss <phase>' command to proactive-amcp.sh
Script should: 1) Analyze phase goal, 2) Generate phase-specific gray areas, 3) Guide discussion, 4) Write CONTEXT.md
CONTEXT.md must clearly separate: Decisions (LOCKED), Claude's Discretion, Deferred Ideas
Verify: discuss creates .planning/phases/XX-name/X-CONTEXT.md

title: Implement plan verification loop
description: Add plan-checker that verifies PRD tasks WILL achieve goal BEFORE execution, with goal-backward analysis
rationale: GSD insight: 'Plan completeness ≠ Goal achievement'. A task existing doesn't mean the goal will be achieved.
steps: Create verify-plan.sh that implements goal-backward verification
Verification dimensions: 1) Requirement coverage, 2) Task completeness, 3) Dependency validity, 4) Context compliance, 5) Scope budget
Check: Every requirement has task(s), no task implements deferred ideas, discretion areas handled
Implement 3-iteration loop: Plan → Check → Revise (if fails)
Add 'gsd verify-plan <prd>' command
Output PLAN-CHECK.md with pass/fail and specific issues
Integrate into ralph.sh: verify PRD before execution
Verify: ralph refuses to run PRD that fails verification

title: Split ralph into specialized agents
description: Create separate agent prompts for researcher, planner, checker, executor, verifier following GSD pattern
rationale: GSD uses specialized agents with clear roles and fresh contexts. This prevents quality degradation and enables parallel execution.
steps: Create agents/ directory for agent prompts
Create agents/researcher.md - investigates how to implement, outputs RESEARCH.md
Create agents/planner.md - creates executable task plans from research
Create agents/checker.md - verifies plans before execution (goal-backward)
Create agents/executor.md - executes tasks atomically with commits
Create agents/verifier.md - verifies code DID achieve goal after execution
Each agent: clear role, mandatory file reads, specific outputs
Add agent spawning to ralph.sh using sessions_spawn
Verify: ralph spawns appropriate agent for each phase

title: Implement wave-based parallel execution
description: Analyze task dependencies and execute independent tasks in parallel waves
rationale: GSD executes independent tasks simultaneously with fresh contexts, dramatically improving throughput.
steps: Create wave-analyzer.sh that parses PRD and builds dependency graph
Identify independent tasks (no dependencies) for Wave 1
Identify tasks that depend on Wave 1 for Wave 2, etc.
Output WAVES.md showing execution order
Modify ralph.sh to spawn parallel sessions for same-wave tasks
Each executor gets fresh context (prevents quality degradation)
Atomic commits per task (not per wave)
Add --parallel flag to ralph: 'ralph --parallel <prd>'
Verify: independent tasks run simultaneously

title: Implement stub detection and wiring verification
description: Add automated verification that checks artifacts are REAL implementations, not placeholders
rationale: GSD insight: 'Existence ≠ Implementation'. Files can exist but be stubs. Must check: Exists → Substantive → Wired → Functional.
steps: Create verify-artifact.sh with stub detection patterns
Detect: TODO/FIXME/placeholder comments, empty returns, hardcoded values, log-only functions
Check wiring: Component → API (fetch exists, response used), API → DB (query exists, result returned)
Verification levels: 1) Exists, 2) Substantive (real content), 3) Wired (connected), 4) Functional (works)
Create patterns for: React components, API routes, DB schemas, hooks, env vars
Output VERIFICATION.md with pass/fail per artifact
Flag items requiring human verification (visual, UX, external services)
Add 'gsd verify <phase>' command
Verify: catches stub implementations in test cases

title: Implement STATE.md continuous updates
description: Update STATE.md after every significant action to enable instant session restoration
rationale: GSD's STATE.md is the project's living memory. Under 100 lines, updated constantly, read first in every workflow.
steps: Create update-state.sh that modifies STATE.md
Track: Current position (phase X of Y, plan A of B), Status, Last activity, Progress bar
Track: Recent decisions (reference to PROJECT.md), Pending todos, Active blockers
Track: Session continuity (last session, stopped at, resume file)
Add performance metrics: velocity, avg duration, trend
Call update-state.sh after: plan creation, task completion, phase transition, decision made
Keep STATE.md under 100 lines (it's a digest, not archive)
Add 'gsd status' command that reads and displays STATE.md
Verify: STATE.md reflects current project state accurately

title: Implement research phase before planning
description: Add automated research step that investigates domain before creating plans
rationale: GSD researches how to implement BEFORE planning. Researcher reads CONTEXT.md to focus investigation.
steps: Create research.sh that spawns research agent
Research agent investigates: stack patterns, feature implementations, architecture approaches, common pitfalls
Input: Phase goal from ROADMAP + CONTEXT.md decisions
Output: RESEARCH.md with findings organized by relevance
Research can use web_search, web_fetch, codebase analysis
Add 'gsd research <phase>' command
Integrate into plan-phase: research → plan → verify loop
Add --skip-research flag for phases where research not needed
Verify: RESEARCH.md contains relevant domain knowledge

title: Implement questioning methodology for context capture
description: Add guided questioning that follows GSD's 'thinking partner' approach, not interviewing
rationale: GSD: 'Start open, follow energy, challenge vagueness, make abstract concrete, know when to stop.'
steps: Create questioning-guide.md reference document
Principles: Dream extraction not requirements gathering, follow the thread not a script
Question types: Motivation (why), Concreteness (what actually), Clarification (do you mean), Success (how know)
Anti-patterns to avoid: checklist walking, canned questions, corporate speak, interrogation, rushing
Context checklist: What building, Why exists, Who for, What done looks like
Implement in discuss.sh: analyze phase, generate gray areas, probe each until satisfied
Add decision gate: 'Ready to create CONTEXT.md?' with keep exploring option
Verify: discuss.sh guides productive conversation, captures concrete decisions

title: Create GSD command aliases for proactive-amcp
description: Add gsd:* style commands to proactive-amcp CLI for familiar workflow
rationale: GSD users know /gsd:plan-phase, /gsd:execute-phase etc. Familiar commands ease adoption.
steps: Add command aliases to proactive-amcp.sh:
gsd init → initialize .planning/ structure
gsd discuss <phase> → capture context before planning
gsd research <phase> → investigate domain
gsd plan <phase> → research → plan → verify loop
gsd execute <phase> → wave-based parallel execution
gsd verify <phase> → goal-backward verification
gsd status → show STATE.md
gsd progress → show roadmap progress
Verify: all gsd commands work and integrate with existing ralph workflow

title: Implement context quality degradation tracking
description: Track context usage % and adjust behavior at thresholds
rationale: GSD insight: Quality degrades as context fills. 0-30% PEAK, 30-50% GOOD, 50-70% DEGRADING, 70%+ POOR.
steps: Create context-monitor.sh that tracks context usage
Get context % from session_status tool
Define thresholds: <30% peak, 30-50% good, 50-70% degrading, >70% poor
At 50%: Warn, recommend checkpoint
At 60%: Auto-checkpoint (existing IPFS trigger)
At 70%: Force task completion, spawn fresh context for next task
Log quality state in STATE.md: 'Context: 45% (GOOD)'
Integrate into ralph: check context before each task
Verify: context warnings appear at correct thresholds

title: Create GSD integration guide
description: Document the GSD-style workflow in SKILL.md and reference docs
rationale: Users need to understand the new workflow: discuss → research → plan → verify → execute → verify
steps: Add 'GSD Workflow' section to SKILL.md
Document each phase: discuss, research, plan, execute, verify
Explain CONTEXT.md: LOCKED vs DISCRETION vs DEFERRED
Explain STATE.md: what it tracks, when updated
Explain verification: goal-backward, stub detection, wiring checks
Add workflow diagram showing phase flow
Create references/gsd-workflow.md with detailed examples
Add FAQ: When to use discuss? What if verification fails?
Verify: new user can follow guide to complete a phase

title: Create all GSD-style templates
description: Port essential GSD templates for consistent artifact creation
rationale: Templates ensure consistent structure across projects and enable tooling integration.
steps: Create templates/ directory
Port: CONTEXT.md (decision capture)
Port: STATE.md (project memory)
Port: PROJECT.md (core vision)
Port: RESEARCH.md (domain investigation)
Port: VERIFICATION.md (goal-backward results)
Create: PLAN-CHECK.md (pre-execution verification)
Create: WAVES.md (parallel execution plan)
Create: SUMMARY.md (task completion record)
Verify: all templates have clear sections and examples

title: Create GSD workflow test suite
description: Test the complete GSD-style workflow end-to-end
rationale: Complex workflow needs automated testing to prevent regressions.
steps: Create test/gsd-workflow-test.sh
Test: gsd init creates proper structure
Test: gsd discuss captures decisions to CONTEXT.md
Test: gsd research outputs RESEARCH.md
Test: gsd plan creates verified plans
Test: verify-plan catches missing requirements
Test: wave-analyzer identifies independent tasks
Test: verify-artifact catches stub implementations
Test: STATE.md updates after each action
Verify: full workflow passes end-to-end

title: Release proactive-amcp with GSD integration
description: Bump to v1.0.0 with GSD workflow as major feature
rationale: GSD integration is a significant workflow change worthy of major version bump.
steps: Update version to 1.0.0 in all files
Update CHANGELOG.md with GSD integration details
Update README.md with GSD workflow overview
Run full test suite
Publish to npm: npm publish
Publish to ClawdHub: clawdhub publish
Announce on Solvr: Post idea about GSD integration
Update local installation
Verify: both registries have v1.0.0
